rgyud gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i mthar thug pa'i lam gyi gnad nga la yod ces mtshon pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la'ang bsdigs na 'jig rten gyi steng 'og sogs phyogs bcu'i gdon 'joms pa lta ci smos pa'o/ /skyes bu gsal shing la bskyon pas ni mi dge ba bcu dang*/ chos spong ba dang*/ mtshams med sogs byas pa'i sdig po che yang btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar ston pa'o/ /de yang dur khrod kyi gsal shing dang 'di mi gcig ste/ dur khrod kyi gsal zhing la btsugs pa ni ro yin la/ 'di ni gang zag go /gnad gcig ni spyir rje btsun sangs rgyas kun gyi yab yin zhing 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi tshe rje btsun la brten nas 'tshang rgya bar byed pa dgos pa ha cang che ba zhig yin mod/ khyad par du rje btsun rim gyis dmar nag 'jigs gsum du khros pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la ni rgyu dus dang 'bras dus dang ye shes sems dpa'i skabs su rje btsun gyi zhal dngos su yod pa las rje btsun gyis rdzas su 'dzin pas 'di'i sgrub pa po shes rab snga ma dmar nag gnyis kyi sgrub pa po las lhag par che ba yin no/ /'di'i rwa gnyis kyis ni gzhi yul kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis kyi gnas tshul/ /lam thabs shes gnyis rgyud la ji ltar bskyed pa/ des sgrub pa'i 'bras bu sku gnyis thob tshul rnams gzhan la med pa mtshon zhing rgyas par ston pa'o/ /de yang mtshon tsam bshad na/ sgrub thabs kyi dag pa'i skabs su rwa gnyis ni bden pa gnyis zhes pa'i bden gnyis la/ gzhi dus kyi bden pa gnyis dang*/ lam dus kyi kun rdzob sgyu lus dang don dam 'od gsal/ 'bras dus kyi chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis sam bden gnyis dbyer med kyi zung 'jug mtshon pa dang*/ phyag so bzhi dang sku gsung thugs gsum bsnan pa'i so bdun gyis lam dran nye sogs byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun/

zhabs bcu drug gis yul stong pa nyid bcu drug rtogs pa'i ye shes bcu drug mtshon zhing*/ des mi sogs bcu drug mnan pas ni de dag gis mtshon pa'i stong nyid bcu drug la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i dngos 'dzin bcu drug zil gyis gnon pa mtshon no/ / yang mi sogs brgyad kyis ral gri sogs dngos grub brgyad dang*/ bya rgod sogs brgyad kyis sku'i dbang phyugs sogs brgyad dag pa mtshon pa sogs dag pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar gzhan nas kyang mang du 'byung ngo*/ /des na 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pas 'di'i rim gnyis la bde gsang gnyis nas bshad pa'i rim gnyis kyi lam 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ bsgoms pa nyid kyis kyang tshe 'dir mchog 'grub par nus so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ chos skyong dang bla ma dang grogs la bsten dgos pa dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong dgos tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de lta bu'i nas/ yin la zhes pa'i bar te/ gong du brjod pa de lta bu'i lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i chos skyong la mdo rgyud gzhan nas gsungs pa'i bka' sdod khyad par can shin tu mang zhing 'gangs che mod/ de lta na'ang gong du bshad pa ltar myur ba'i dbang du byas pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang mthun pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin la/ de la ni 'chad 'gyur gyi chos skyong gsum po 'di sten dgos so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen po'i chos skyong ngo*/ /dang po ni/ skyes bu gsum gyi khyad par gong du brjod zin cing*/ de la skyes bu chung ngu'i zhes pa nas/ las gshin bsten par bya'o zhes pa'i bar te/ de la skyes bu chung ngu'i bsam pa ni/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring du mi gnas pas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa dang*/

de las skyob pa'i skyabs 'gro bslab bya dang bcas pa bsam zhing rgyud la skye dgos pas/ de lta bu'i lam 'di rgyud la bskyed pa la gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bsten dgos te/ chos rgyal 'di ni 'chi bdag gam/ dge sdig gi dpang po'am/ sdig pa can gyi chad las mkhan nam/ dge ba can gyi bstangs 'dzin te grogs byed pa'am/ dkar nag gi las rgyu 'bras gsal byed kyi me long ste las dkar nag gnyis gang byas pa dang mthun pa'i tshar gcod rjes 'dzin byed pa/ legs nyes tshul bzhin du spyod pa'am chos bzhin du spyod pas chos rgyal zhes bya zhing*/ las dkar nag gi rjes su 'jug pas na las kyi gshin rje zhes bya'o/ /des na skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor 'di rnams ni theg pa gsum gyi lam mam skyes bu gsum dang thun mong ba'i lam gsum ga'i rtsa ba yin pas 'di rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir du las kyi gshin rje chos skyong du bsten par bya'o/ /'o na chos rgyal 'di ni 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa gang yin zhe na/ 'di ni 'di'i lo rgyus kyi rtog pa ltar na/ 'jam dpal 'jigs byed kyi skur bzhengs te/ lca mkhar sgo med bcu drug zhabs bcu drug gis mnan nas btul bar bshad pa dang*/ tā ra nā tha'i chos 'byung du de min gzhan zhig kyang bshad pa ltar na 'jig rten pa yin pa ltar snang yang*/ don la chos rgyal la phyi nang gsang gsum 'byung ba'i rigs pa dang*/ paṇa chen gong ma'i chos rgyal gyi bskang gso'i bla med kyi rten gyi skabs su/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir gshin rje'i skur bstan yang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig 'di 'jam dpal gyi 'phrin las kyi sprul par bzhed pa 'dug pa ltar kho bo yang de ltar du bsams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes bu 'bring nas bslab pa srung ba'o zhes pa'i bar te/ skyes bu 'bring gi bsam pa ni/

'jig rten phyi ma'i bde ba'i thabs su ma zad/ 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'obs sam me dong lta bur mthong nas de dang 'bral 'dod thar ba don gnyer gyi blo nges 'byung gi bams pa can yin la/ yang 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med par mthong nas de la yid skyo zhing nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo yin zhing*/ snga ma dang 'di gnyis don gcig pas so/ /des na lam de rgyud la skye ba'i ched du rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras chos skyong du bsten dgos te/ 'di sde snod gsum gyi nang nas 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi srung ma'am/ bslab pa gsum gyi nang nas tshul khrims kyi bslab pa bsrung ba'o/ /'o na/ rnam sras 'di 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gang yin snyam na/ lo rgyus 'ga' zhig las rgyal po chen po bzhi ka rgyun zhugs bshad la/ lo rgyus gzhan zhig dang 'di'i bskang gso'i gzhung las/ sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /ces sa brgyad pa bar gsungs shing*/ kha cig 'di phyag rdor gyi sprul par bzhed/ 'ga' zhig bskang gso'i gzhung las/ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ste/ /zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas rin chen mang gi sprul pa'o zhes gsungs te brtag /gang ltar yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'phags chen zhig 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul bzung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skyes bu chen po'i nas chos skyong yin pas so zhes pa'i bar te/ skyes bu chen po'i bsam pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor ba las thar ba tsam gyis mi chog par mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar bar 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems rgyud la bskyed pa yin la/ de rgyud la skye ba'i phyir du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba mgon po phyag drug pa chos skyong du bstan dgos te/ 'di ni snying rje can gyi chos skyong yin pas so/ /de'i 'phros sam zhar byung lta bur/

shes rab bam lta ba rnam dag rgyu la bskyed pa la gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bsten dgos te/ 'di ni shes rab can gyi chos skyong yin pa'am/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bka' sdod yin pas so zhes gsungs so/ /mgon po phyag drug pa 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par grags che zhing*/ 'on kyang mgon po'i bskang gso'i gzhung las/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po ni/ /zhes sa bcu pa bar bshad pa ni spyan ras gzigs sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa de'i dbang du mdzad kyi/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la ni spyan ras gzigs sangs rgyas su nges par 'dod dgos te/ bla med ltar na rigs gsum mgon po'i bskyed rdzogs la brten nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya nus par bshad pas/ kho rang rnams sangs rgyas min na 'di dag gi bskyed rdzogs la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba yang ga la srid/ sangs rgyas yin par ma zad dang po'i sangs rgyas yin par lung rigs du mas bsgrub nus te ma spros so/ /mdor na 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po sangs rgyas min na/ sangs rgyas mi srid ces 'dod dgos par snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa bla ma ni/ de lta bu'i nas/ bsten par bya'o zhes pa'i bar te/ sngar bshad pa de lta bu'i mdo sngags kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i bla ma yang yon tan phyogs re ba rnyed pa tsam gyis mi chog gi so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum gyi bsnon bri shes pa dang*/ de dag rang rang gi nyes ltung dang bral ba/ 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde'i sde snod gsum gyi tshig don la mkhas shing*/ de'i brjod bya tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa/ bya spyod yo ga bla med kyi rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas shing bum dbang sogs dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pas/ rang rgyud bskyed rdzogs kyis lam skye ba'i snod rung du byas nas lam zab mo gnyis nyams su len cing*/

myong ba thon nas gzhan la brtse bas 'doms par mdzad pa ste/ mdor na rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur ba las kyang ches myur bar mngon du byed pa'i zab lam khyad par can phyin ci ma log par yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i bla ma zhig bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas bsten par bya'o/ /gsum pa grogs ni/ lam tshul bzhin du nas mthun pa zhig dgos so zhes pa'i bar te/ de lta bu'i lam tshul bzhin du sgrub ba'i grogs kyang bla ma dang yon tan cha mthun zhig dgos la/ grogs rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad la/ las 'bras la dad pa dang*/ rang dang chos rgyu mtshan du byas nas ngo tsha shes shing*/ gzhan gyis khrel dogs nas khrel yod 'dzin pa/ 'gran sems che ba zhes pa 'di chung ba la bsgyur na go bde ba ltar snang yang yig nor du 'jog ma nus shing*/ gzhan la 'gran sems che ba la byas na mi legs pas/ dam pa gong ma'i mdzad spyod khyad par can dang 'gran cig mthun par sgrub pa byed pa la sbyar na rung ngam snyam du sems te brtagabazhi pa tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la gnyis/ tshogs gsog dang*/ sgrib sbyong ngo*/ /dang po ni/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i nas bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar te/ gong du bshad pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam de lta bu sngar ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob zin brtan par byed pa/ brtan pa gong 'phel du byed pa la bla ma yi dam dbyer med du byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ tshogs gsog cing sgrib pa sbyong ba/ gzhung chen mo la lta ba gsum sum bsgril du byed dgos la/ tshogs gsog pa'i tshul/ de la thog mar tshogs zhing gsal 'debs dgos pas de ni/ rang gi spyi bor ram de'i thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du ngo bo chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin pa la/ rnam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser phyag g.yas pa shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs ka nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ 'dzum sgeg zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i rnam pa can du gsal gdab la/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon nam/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsams te bstims nas/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta dang*/ rū pa nas/ spar+sha'i bar dang*/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa'am/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs dang*/ sa gzhi spos kyi mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul la/ mtshams sprin ma lta bu dang*/ dmigs brtse ma ci 'grub dang*/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer mi phyed pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes lan mang du gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab nas/ yang de'i mjug tu bdag gi rgyud la nges 'byung byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba phyin drug bslab gsum rim gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag skye bar byin gyi rlob tu gsol/ skye bar gyur cigazhes lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam shugs drag la rgyun ring du gsol ba btab/ de nas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo nas gsol ba 'debs so/

/bdag la dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ / sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol/ sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum dang*/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rje btsun gyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bcas rim par byung nas/ rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum du rim pa bzhin du zhugs/ slar yang yi ge las bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum cig car byung nas rang gi gnas gsum du cig car du zhugs shing thim pas/ sgo gsum so so dang*/ thun mong pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi thob/ sprul sku sogs sku bzhi 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag par gyur/ de nas bla ma dang yi dam gyi gsol 'debs smon lam gyi 'bras bu 'grub par zhal gyis bzhes par bsams la/ mthar/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med bdag nyid kyi/ /spyi bor byon nas tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ /snying gar thig le ga'u kha sbyar dbus/ /bzhugs nas byin brlabs rjes su bzung bar gyur/ / ces dang*/ skye ba kun tu zhes sogs bsngo smon bya'o zhes pa ni gzhung gi tshig 'grel dang 'jug pa gcig tu byas so/ /gnyis pa sgrib sbyong ni/ sgrib pa sbyong ba la nas/ bla na med pa'o zhes pa'i bar te/ sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs la ltung bshags phyag dang bcas pa dang*/ yi ge brgya ba'i sgom bzlas grags che ba de lta bu dang*/ yig chung nyer gcig nas 'byung ba'i dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ de nas 'byung ba ltar za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dang*/ sogs kyis zab mo'i mdo rgyud dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan brjod pa sogs te mdor na stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sbyang ba gnad che/ de yang sdig pa'i 'bras bu rnam smin yid du mi 'ong pa mthong nas sdig pa sngar byed la 'gyod sems dang*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed bsam pa'i sdom sems brtan par byed pa ni sdig pa sbyong thabs bla na med

pa'o/ / gsum pa don bsdu ba la gnyis/ gzhung chen mo rnams la thos bsam byed dgos pa dang*/ sngar bshad pa rnams kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung chen mo nas nges par brtag dgos pa'i bar te/ shes rab che ba dag gis mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mo rnams la lta dgos shing*/ lta ba yang sngags mtshan nyid kyi gsung rab bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gang la yang gzhung de'i dngos bstan dang shugs bstan dang bstan bya'i gtso bo dang*/ gzhung de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya gang yin dang*/ gzhung de dag gong 'og gi 'grel tshul rnams ci ltar yin nges par brtag dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdor na zhes pa nas/ gtan 'dra ba min no zhes pa'i bar te/ mdor na thog mar bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste 'bras bu chos longs sprul ba'i sku gsum gyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i bar gyi lam thun mong bas rgyu sbyangs pa sngon du btang dgos shing*/ de'ang sku gsum gyi lam thun mong ba nas rim gyis 'khrid tshul/ thun mong ma yin pa bsngags lam la 'jug pa la yang dbang rnam par dag pa thob pa/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du srung ba/ rim gnyis rgyud la bskyed tshul sogs grangs nges dang go rim dang lam so so'i ngo bo rnams myong ba thon par rgyud la bskyed cing go ba chags par byed pa dang*/ 'di dag la myong ba thon pa lta zhog 'di dag gi don la rags pa'i bshar sgom tsam re byed pa la yang lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len gyi gnad tshang ba yin pas/ sa chod dang dge sbyor phran tshegs byed tshul gzhan dang gtan 'dra ba min te/ khyad du 'phags pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /lam gyi ngo bo dang grangs dang go rim la rgyas bsdus kyi dbang dang mdo sngags skabs stobs kyis mi 'dra ba yod kyang*/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa thun mong ba 'di ni phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i grangs dang go rim kyang yin par snang la/

gzhan theg pa gsum gyi lam lnga'i rim pa yang rang rang gi lam gyi ngo bo dang drang nges dang go rim du 'gyur zhing*/ theg chen la ni tshogs sbyor dang sa bcu yang de'i sa lam gyi go rim yin no/ /bla med la ni dbang gis rgyud snod rung du byas te/ bskyed rim gyis sku gsum 'grub pa'i rgyud smin par byas rjes rdzogs rim la 'jug pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rim pa lnga yang de'i lam gyi ngo bo dang go rim du 'gyur bar snang ste rags tsam sngar bshad zin to/ /gsum pa mjug gi don la/ gzhung 'di brtsams pa'i rgyu ni sngar bshad pa ltar gyi rgyu mtshan des na/ bla ma rje btsun re mda' ba zhal snga nas kyis rje btsun la zhus la/ myong ba la bkar ba'i dge sbyor byed tshul snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la bogs che ba'i nyams len gyi gnad yongs su rdzogs pa zhig zhus la bskur zhing gsung pa'i gsung shog nan can bskur byung ba'i dbang gis/ bdag rje btsong kha pas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul nas gsol ba drag po phur tshugs su btab pa la brten nas/ tshe gcig la rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ches shin tu nas kyang myur bar mngon du byed pa'i lam gyi gnas thams cad ma tshang bar med par yongs su rdzogs pa gcig tu dril nas/ nyams su len tshul 'di bzhin gyis zhes gsung ba'i rje btsun gyi gsung ngag yi ger btab nas phul ba lags/ nyams len gyi gnad 'di lta bu ches cher nas kyang shin tu dkon cing snod min la gsang ba mthar thug par 'dug pas gzhan la gtan nas mi ston par zhu zhu zhes gsungs pa ni sgro skur 'byung bar dogs pa'o/ /phul ba 'di ni rje btsun gyi gsung gi snying po bsdus pa yin gyi/ 'di dag gi don re re bzhin rje btsun gyis zhi bar gsung ba rnams 'dir 'bri bar ma lang bas nam nyid zhal mjal dus su zhu bar smon lags/

zhu yig gi rten du hang khrung ja ser po zho lnga phul bas dge legs su gyur cig ces pa ni gsung ngos ma'o/ /sngon ma de'i dbu na tshigs bcad med cing mjug tu yod pa dang*/ 'di'i dbu na tshigs bcad yod cing mjug tu med pa ltar na/ 'di dang sngon ma de gnyis 'jug pa gcig tu mdzad pa'i nges pa mi snang ngo*/ /de'i mjug tu/ rje btsun re mda' pa'i zhu yig lan rje thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha bas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la zhus nas phul ba'i nyams len gyi gnad yongs su rdzogs par dril nas thugs nyams su bzhes tshul lo zhes pa ni gzhan gyi bcug pa ste/ gzhung 'di'i mtshan kyang yin no/ /smras pa/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /thugs bcud man ngag legs bshad pad brgya'i tshal/ /blo gros nyi ma'i 'od kyis deng phye nas/ /dgongs don snying po ze'u 'bru gsal bar byas/ /dam pa'i gsung gi daṇ+ḍis nyer bskul bas/ /dbang bral blo chung dun+du bhi ngos su/ /gsang chen chos kyi sgra chen bsgrags thal bas/ /gang thugs sgra 'dzin lhan cig tshim gyur cig /rgya mtshos chu phran rtag 'thungs kyang*/ /ngoms med ji bzhin chos kyi tshul/ /don gnyer can dag legs bshad kyis/ /chog shes mi mnga' ngang tshul nyid/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor gnas bcas shing*/ /legs bshad rin chen gtsug bsten pa'i/ /mkhas mchog gdegs can dbang mang yang*/ /rje btsun nyid dang lhan cig dri ba'i gzhung*/ /zung gi dgongs don legs par 'grel byed pa'i/ /bgo skal bka' babs skal ba che ldan pa/ /deng dus kho bo nyid las gzhan na gang*/ /rim gnyis gzhung brgya'i dgongs don phyogs gcig tu/ /sdud 'dod nyung ngu'i rjod byed kyi spras pas/ /ma gsal log par bshad pa'i nyes mchis na/ /gzur gnas dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags/ /gang gang legs par bshad las thob pa'i rnam dkar ji snyed mchis gyur de/
